product.name: Apple 61W USB-C Charger
product.full_name: Genuine 61W USB-C Power Adapter for MacBook Pro 13" / MacBook 12"
product.description: Genuine Apple power adapter (Model A1718, Apple Part No. MNF72LL/A) recommended for the 13-inch MacBook Pro with Two Thunderbolt 3 (USB-C) ports (2016-2020). Also works with the 12-inch MacBook Retina (2015-2017) and 13-inch MacBook Air (2018-2020) since these lower-wattage models simply draw what they need. Delivers up to 61W over USB-C (20.3V, 3A). Charging cable sold separately. Wide-range 100–240V AC input for worldwide use. Original Apple unit, tested before dispatch.

delivery_note: Same-day delivery in Nairobi · 1–2 days upcountry
